entries.name: On Attack / On Crit (+ Wielding: Polearm)
On Attack / On Crit (+ Wielding: Blade)

system.description: A protective suit of armor designed for the frontline soldier.
A lightweight shield, providing minimal defenses.

As a Bonus Action, relocate an adjacent unit, pulling them backwards. You also move backwards in the same direction. If the target unit is hostile to you, you must first pass an Athletics check (DC 3 + target's Bld).

The target must be the same size as the user. If the target is airborne, the user must be able to reach it in melee.
A well-crafted, well-balanced, double-edged sword. The minimum standard of quality for common soldiers and adventurers.
